title: Are Nazi War Criminals Still At Large?
summary: Josh Clark and Chuck (transcribed as Chris) discuss Nazi war criminals still at large, prompted by a HowStuffWorks article on the Simon Wiesenthal Center's Operation Last Chance. They cover Mossad's pursuit of Nazis (capturing Adolf Eichmann in Argentina and Klaus Barbie), Mossad's reported employment of a Nazi doctor linked to mobile gas vans, and how the US (Project Paperclip, Wernher von Braun) and CIA and the British also employed former Nazis for their skills. The transcript is garbled by speech-recognition errors, so some names and details are uncertain.

segments.title: Opening and Operation Last Chance
segments.summary: Hosts introduce the topic of whether Nazi war criminals are still at large, referencing a Simon Wiesenthal Center effort called Operation Last Chance.

segments.title: Mossad and Nazi hunting
segments.summary: Mossad is described as having pursued Nazis for decades, capturing Adolf Eichmann (kidnapped in Argentina) and finding Klaus Barbie. The hosts say Mossad also reportedly employed a Nazi doctor who devised mobile gas vans disguised as Red Cross ambulances.

segments.title: Governments employing former Nazis
segments.summary: The hosts discuss how governments, including the US, Britain and the CIA, took on former Nazis for useful skills. Project Paperclip is described as a secret US project to recruit Nazi scientists, including Wernher von Braun, and Eichmann is said to have been used by the CIA as a West German agent.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Hosts wrap up the episode and point listeners to HowStuffWorks.com for more.
